question: How many jobs will the U.S. economy add in November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Anchor: 2026 YTD avg ~86k, 3-mo revised avg 137k (Aug 186k, Sep 60k, Oct 165k); October beat consensus (~60k) massively. Claims low (~200k, 4wk 195k), ADP weekly pulse ~20k/week (~80k/mo). Expect some mean reversion after a big beat; consensus for Nov likely ~70-110k. Polymarket bucket ladder (thin, ~$5k total) implies median ~95-100k with fat tails (18% <25k, 20% >=150k). First prints in 2026 volatile (Feb -156k revised), so wide tails including escape mass both sides.
calls.dossier:
- BLS Employment Situation (Nov 6, 2026): Oct 2026 NFP +165k (private +159k); consensus ~59-65k; prior 12-mo avg ~48k/mo; unemployment 4.1%; gains: prof/business services +70k, health care +42k, transport/warehousing +25k.
- Revisions in Oct report: Aug 133k->186k, Sep 29k->60k (+84k combined). BLS 90% CI on monthly change ±122k.
- 2026 revised monthly path (search aggregate): Jan +160k, Feb -156k, Mar +214k, Apr +148k, May +63k, Jun +31k, Jul -10k, Aug +186k, Sep +60k, Oct +165k; YTD avg ~86k/mo (Economic Times, Nov 12). 2025 avg ~9.7k/mo.
- Initial first prints Aug-Oct 2026: 133k, 29k, 165k.
- Jobless claims week ending Nov 7: 200k (vs 194k expected), 4-wk avg 195,250; at/below 200k nine straight weeks; continuing claims 1.697M (AA/DoL, Nov 12).
- ADP NER Oct 2026 private +86k; weekly pulse avg +19,750/week for 4 weeks to Oct 24; next pulses Nov 17, Nov 24 (ADP, Nov 4).
- S&P 500 fell 4.36% on Nov 5; Fed (Chair Warsh) meets Dec 8-9, most officials projecting a hike. No strike/weather effects identified for Nov.
- Status quo: monthly change near recent trend; first prints in 2026 have ranged roughly -150k to +200k.
- Resolves off BLS initial Employment Situation release for Nov 2026 (Dec 4, 2026), SA total nonfarm change, not later revisions or ADP.
- Event window: November 2026 reference month, reported Dec 4, 2026; as of Nov 14 survey reference week (week incl. Nov 12) has passed, data not yet released.
- Searched but not found: published November consensus estimate; Nov ADP weekly data after Oct 24.

calls.reconciliation: Runs agreed closely (medians 82-88k, widths 135-140k); disputes were judgment (degree of mean reversion after Oct beat; tail mass). Run 3 reported percentiles in thousands rather than jobs - a units error, corrected by working in jobs per the bounds. Checked: (1) ADP NER Pulse - confirmed 19,750/wk avg through Oct 24, no newer data; (2) November 2026 consensus - none found; a '40k November' figure surfaced was FactSet's 2025 number and was discarded. Carried forward the 2026-initial-print reference class and ~135k width. Polymarket ladder on the identical BLS first-print contract is thin but consistent with median ~90k; used as evidence, not anchor. Settled on median ~84k with upside escape slightly heavier than downside.
